name: Aggressive Playing 3-4-3

slots.why: The sweeper keeper covers the high space behind the three defenders.
The ball-playing stopper steps into duels and carries the ball into midfield when space opens.
The ball-playing cover defender sweeps behind the press and begins the next attack calmly.
The remaining defender provides a stable passing outlet beside the stopper-cover pair.
The attacking wing-back supplies the left-side width of the five-lane attack.
The right wing-back mirrors the aggressive width on the other side.
The box-to-box midfielder supports the press and arrives around the box.
The deep-lying playmaker connects the back three to the forward line.
The winger holds the left lane while the wing-back overlaps underneath.
The inside forward attacks the box from the right.
The pressing forward starts the press and leads the runs beyond the defence.

description: A high-line 3-4-3 that pairs an aggressive ball-playing stopper with a ball-playing cover defender and attacks through wing-backs.
whyGood: It offers an actual tactical home to proactive centre-backs who can both defend forward and progress possession.
whyThisShape: The stopper attacks the first duel, the cover defender protects behind him, and the third defender keeps the build-up stable. Wing-backs create the width while the front three press and occupy the final line.
whenToUse: When your centre-backs are quick, brave and technically secure, and you want to dominate territory with a back three.
whenNotToUse: Against quick direct counters if the cover defender lacks pace or the wing-backs cannot recover.

instructionRationale.Much Higher Line of Engagement: Starts the press close to the opponent so the stopper can defend forward.
instructionRationale.Higher Defensive Line: Keeps the back three connected to midfield, but makes pace and anticipation essential.
instructionRationale.Shorter Passing: Uses the three ball-playing defenders and DLP to retain the ball after regains.
instructionRationale.Play Out Of Defence: Creates several technically capable first-line passers.
instructionRationale.Counter-Press: Wins the ball back before space behind the wing-backs can be attacked.
